title: Anthropic IPO Filing Calms Nerves With Signs of Healthy Growth
summary: Anthropic opened its books to IPO investors just after a rough week for AI stocks, and Wall Street generally liked the signs of healthy growth. The filing eased some investor nerves about the AI trade.

title: Healthcare Stocks Become Anti-AI Bet as Investors Turn Defensive
summary: With confidence in the AI trade under pressure, investors are turning to healthcare stocks as a defensive, anti-AI bet.

title: Dutch Plan to Cut 25,000 Jobs Will Show Whether AI Can Shrink Government
summary: The Dutch government plans to cut 25,000 civil servant jobs through an AI-led efficiency drive, perhaps the most ambitious such public-sector plan yet. Making it work and replicating it elsewhere could prove tricky.

title: Bending Spoons Seeks $1.5 Billion in Debt to Fund Acquisitions
summary: Bending Spoons is tapping debt markets for $1.5 billion, partly to pursue its acquisition-led growth strategy.

title: AI Talent War Has Quant Firms Racing to Fund PhDs, Build Labs
summary: Quant firms are racing to fund PhDs and build labs as the AI boom creates new competition for top scientific talent. Some of finance's most secretive employers are recruiting publicly.

title: Anthropic Relies on Close Connections With Amazon, Google and Microsoft
summary: Anthropic's prospectus shows deep ties to Amazon, Google and Microsoft, which invest in it and supply compute while also competing with it.

title: Quebec’s La Caisse to Buy BCE Towers Stake for $1.7 Billion
summary: Quebec's pension manager La Caisse will buy 49.9% of BCE's wireless towers for $1.7 billion, giving BCE cash to pare debt or fund its AI strategy.

title: Anthropic IPO Filing Reveals $417 Billion in Future AI Spending
summary: Anthropic filed for one of the largest IPOs in history, and the prospectus reveals about $417 billion in future AI spending commitments. The filing suggests the company may need to raise more capital.

title: Microsoft Alumni Score Funding to Build AI Agents for Finance

title: JPMorgan Private Bank on How to Balance AI Exposure
